references.text: The two men sent out as spies by Joshua are mentioned here at the beginning of their mission
Rahab instructed the spies to hide in the hills for three days, which they have now done before returning
Continuation of the spies' report to Joshua, where they express their faith that the Lord has given them the land
Moses also sent spies who returned and reported on the land, a parallel to this mission
Caleb describes how he returned to Moses and reported what he had seen, like the spies here
Joshua son of Nun is introduced as the leader, and it is to him that the spies now report
